purpose: Storyboard animatic for real actors: three client-story UGC pieces, 9:16, assembled into one reel. AI characters stand in for the actors; consistency of face and voice across each story matters, realism of the brand claim does not (it is a storyboard, not an ad).
format: 9:16, 1080x1920 target, three stories of four 8 s clips each, jump cuts, each clip's own dialogue, captions burned in, a title card before each story, about 100 s total
status: reel v1 sent 2026-09-20; awaiting client feedback

openart.consistency: Clip 1 of each story is generated with the character image as the only element and its voice described in the prompt; its audio becomes the voice reference. Clips 2 to 4 take the image plus that audio and say which subject speaks with it.

house_style: GBX Professional Services in full; G B X P S dot com in speech; no em dashes; no financial advice claims; no revenue or dollar outcomes in the lines.

characters.name: Jess
characters.brief: 34, co-founder of a small mortgage broking firm. Office corner, soft window light, afternoon, plant behind her.
characters.voice: Quick and bright, clear and a little higher, light Australian lean, friendly.

priya: Nobody tells you this when you start a practice. You become the bottleneck.
I did the free Business Health Check on the GBX Professional Services site. Two minutes. It said my problem was process, not sales.
So we did the ten-day Performance Diagnostic. Fixed fee. They talked to my team, not just me. I got a written report and a ninety-day plan that I own.
Three months on, work leaves this office without going through me. Start with the free check. Link's in my bio.
mark: I thought I needed more leads. Turns out I needed a pipeline I could actually read.
The GBX Professional Services team started with our numbers, our process and our pipeline. In that order. No slide deck.
The only AI they put in was the boring stuff. Quote follow-ups. Job sheets. Nothing my guys had to learn.
Practical, and only where it helped. That's the whole review. G B X P S dot com.
jess: Every consultant I have met wanted to sell me something at the end.
GBX Professional Services has no licence and no products. So the advice isn't tied to anything. That's why I picked them.
They also ran a money session for my team. Plain language, at work, no pitch. My staff still talk about it.
A clearer picture, not more advice. Free tools first, then the Diagnostic if you want it.

rounds.feedback: Client: Mark's position in the cab looked unnatural; fixed by re-posing the sheet before his clips were rendered.
notes: Voice references from the seed clips held across every later clip.
Captions must not hold across section ends; captions-9x16.py now takes clamp_ends and stitch-ugc.py writes a sections sidecar.

method_notes: Voice seeds: the character image is the only element; the voice is described in the prompt and the model generates it. The seed's audio is extracted to mono 44.1 kHz mp3 and uploaded through openart_upload_sign plus a curl PUT, then confirmed with openart_upload_metadata_get.
Later clips: image plus audio elements, prompt says the person in image 1 speaks with the voice in audio 1. Clip durations sized to the line: about 2.5 words a second plus a beat.
